title: A Systematic Study of Performance Disparities in Multilingual Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing task performance metrics (e.g., Accuracy, F1, JGA, BLEU) of task-oriented dialogue systems across different languages (English, Arabic, French, Turkish) using absolute and relative performance equivalence thresholds to quantify intrinsic bias (target language under-representation in multilingual pretrained language models) and adaptation bias (scarcity of in-language training data).
